chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
He said to me: 'If you perform ghusl in Makkah, then sleep before you perform Tawaf, so repeat your ghusl.'
ai.seo_question: Does sleeping invalidate the ghusl performed in Makkah before Tawaf?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), this hadith clarifies the specific conditions under which the major ritual bath (*ghusl al-ihram*) is considered nullified during Hajj. It establishes that sleep acts as a disruptor of ritual purity in this context, requiring the pilgrim to renew their *ghusl* before performing *Tawaf*, thereby emphasizing the strict adherence to physical and spiritual cleanliness required for the sacred rites.
